name: Your profile
title: Your profile: whether you have a rouh.land account and whether this Rouh is connected to it, what is wrong between them if anything is, and the one way to connect it

permissions: reads what this Rouh keeps about its registration on rouh.land (its birth row)

asks rouh.land how this Rouh's keys stand as an administrator opens the page, at most once in five minutes, and again when they press Try again beside an error (the same ask as the gene log's beat makes every six hours)
accounts: the owner's account on rouh.land, once this Rouh is connected there
touches.remove: Delete this manifest, rouh/landaccount.py, rouh/web/landaccount.py and its route, landaccountpage.js and landaccountpage.css, the your-profile section in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, its line in app/runs.js's settingsPages and its line in rouh/anatomy.py's CHECKS. What it shows is still on Rouh profile.
